s: grammar school (UK), prep school (US) (school used to prepare students for university)
to complete a grammar school education
So weit gehet das jetzige Vorhaben, welches auf keine ander Ursachen gegründet ist, als auf die Erbauung der in unserm Gymnasio studirenden Jugend.
Thus far goes the current undertaking, founded on no cause but the uplifting of the youth studying in our grammar school.
Gymnasium.et: Borrowed from Latin gymnasium, from Ancient Greek γυμνάσιον (gumnásion, “exercise, school”), from γυμνός (gumnós, “naked”).

s: the gynecology department of a hospital (plural possible)
gyro, gyros (Greek dish of meat cut from a gyrating roasting spit)
a sandwich filled with such meat and, usually, vegetables and sauce

Gymnastik.et: 18th century, from Ancient Greek γυμναστική (gumnastikḗ), in part through Latin gymnastica.

Gymnasiast.et: Borrowed from New Latin gymnasiasta, from Latin gymnasium.

Gymnast.et: Learned borrowing from Ancient Greek γυμναστής (gumnastḗs, “trainer of athletes”).
